# Tipos de App Bridge {#app-bridge-types}

Los tipos que se usan en las páginas de App Bridge, y todos los tipos a los que hacen referencia, de [`@shopify/app-bridge-types`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@shopify/app-bridge-types) 0.7.5. `polaris-vue-elements/app-bridge` reexporta los que exporta el paquete. Las descripciones son el propio JSDoc de Shopify, en inglés.

- [Autenticación y datos](/es/app-bridge/types/authentication-and-data): [`AppApi`](/es/app-bridge/types/authentication-and-data#appapi), [`AppBridgeConfig`](/es/app-bridge/types/authentication-and-data#appbridgeconfig), [`EnvironmentApi`](/es/app-bridge/types/authentication-and-data#environmentapi), [`IdTokenApi`](/es/app-bridge/types/authentication-and-data#idtokenapi), [`Scopes`](/es/app-bridge/types/authentication-and-data#scopes), [`UserApi`](/es/app-bridge/types/authentication-and-data#userapi)

<div class="ab-member">

<p class="ab-sig"><code v-pre><span class="ab-name">sidekick</span>: <a href="/es/app-bridge/types/user-interface-and-interactions#sidekickapi">SidekickApi</a></code></p>

Start Sidekick conversations for the merchant from your app.

`shopify.sidekick` is always defined, but its methods reject when Sidekick isn't available to the app, for example in the Shopify mobile app or on a store without Sidekick. Feature-detect with `isEnabled()` and treat a rejection as unavailable.

</div>

<div class="ab-member">

<p class="ab-sig"><code v-pre><span class="ab-name">tools</span>: <a href="/es/app-bridge/types/user-interface-and-interactions#tools">Tools</a></code></p>

Entry point for Shopify tools.

Enables apps to bind runtime handler functions for tools already declared in app extension configuration, which can be invoked by the platform on behalf of the app. Registered tools are scoped to the current app and persist for the lifetime of the app or until explicitly removed.

</div>
